title: niphobolus boothii
intro: Niphobolus boothii, commonly known as Dammara or Himalayan Nephrolepis, is a species of fern in the family Nephrolepidaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus boothii include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
